en.hubeali: H 14960 – Aban, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws has said:

‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> tightened a glimmering belt around his<sup>asws</sup> abdomen on the Day of Al-Jamal which Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> had descended with from the sky, and the Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to wear it around his<sup>saww</sup> abdomen whenever he<sup>saww</sup> wore the armour’.
en.sarwar: 513. Aban, from Al-Fazeyl Bin Yasaar, who has said:

Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said: ‘Usman said to Al-Miqdad (ar), ‘By Allah (azwj), stop insulting me or I will return you (ar) to your (ar) First Lord (azwj)’. He (a.s.) said: ‘So when the death presented itself to Al-Miqdad (ar), he (ar) said to Ammar, ‘Make it reach to Usman from me (ar) that I (ar) have returned to my (ar) First Lord (azwj)’.
